source_text: Immediate health risks include severe pain, hemorrhage, infection, and shock, while long-term consequences encompass chronic urinary issues, menstrual problems, obstetric complications like fistula and newborn death, sexual dysfunction, and psychological trauma such as depression and post-traumatic stress.
